{
  "name": "tokencraft",
  "displayName": "Tokencraft",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A Minecraft-inspired world for Claude Code: tool calls become blocks and XP, the sky follows your context, the weather follows your plan limits",
  "author": {
    "name": "Daniel Podolsky",
    "url": "https://github.com/DanielPodolsky"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/DanielPodolsky/tokencraft",
  "repository": "https://github.com/DanielPodolsky/tokencraft",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "hud",
    "minecraft-inspired",
    "pixel-art",
    "gamification",
    "focus-timer"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "px_per_column": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Desktop band: pixels per column",
      "description": "How wide one column of the Desktop band is, in pixels. Raise it if the world stops short of the band's right edge, lower it if it's cut off. /f3 shows the band's columns and pixels.",
      "default": 8.35,
      "min": 4,
      "max": 20
    }
  }
}
